scenes.heading: Fact #1
scenes.body: ChatGPT reached 100 million users in just 2 months — the fastest growing app in history.
scenes.narration: ChatGPT became the fastest growing app ever, hitting 100 million users in just two months.
At its core, AI uses neural networks that mimic how our brain processes information.

bullets: Write code better than most devs
scenes.narration: Modern AI can write code, generate images, translate languages, and even beat world champions at chess.
And the AI market has exploded from 50 billion to over 300 billion dollars in just four years.
